question: Do publicly accessible ERDB and 2024 symposium records expose the underlying Pasig River biodiversity assessment data or an independent fish species-by-site dataset?

materialsReviewed.locator: 2023 Q3 report, page 6, legal services section, MOA/MOU review accomplishments.
materialsReviewed.accessMethod: Official ERDB-hosted PDF text returned in indexed search results; no local copy retained.
materialsReviewed.result: The accomplishment list includes an MOA for the Pasig River Biodiversity Assessment Project. The report excerpt does not expose agreement terms or biological results.

materialsReviewed.locator: 4th Philippine Symposium on Freshwater Biodiversity and Ecosystems program listing for Pasig River phytoplankton-based water-quality work.
materialsReviewed.accessMethod: Directly opened the society-hosted program PDF and reviewed the matching presentation title and presenter affiliation.
materialsReviewed.result: The program lists Yves Christian L. Cabillon, DENR, for a Pasig River water-quality assessment using phytoplankton as biological indicators. No abstract or supporting data appear in the listing.

locators: 10th Asian Wetlands Symposium program, wetland-biodiversity parallel session: Pasig River rotifer presentation.
10th Asian Wetlands Symposium program, wetland-biodiversity poster session: Pasig River macroinvertebrate comparison.
materialsReviewed.accessMethod: Directly opened the program-book PDF and reviewed the matching titles and presenter affiliations.
materialsReviewed.result: The program lists an ERDB rotifer presentation by Yves Christian L. Cabillon and an ERDB macroinvertebrate comparison poster by Anneraj Velasco. No abstract, taxon table, station list, or dataset appears in the program listing.

searches: Exact search for the 2024 Pasig phytoplankton presentation title and presenter.
Exact search for the Pasig rotifer and macroinvertebrate program titles.
ERDB-domain searches for Pasig River biodiversity assessment reports and fish data.
Search for a public report or PDF under the Pasig River Biodiversity Assessment Project name.
boundedSearch.result: The indexed public results surfaced the agency accomplishment listing and symposium programs, but no separate public data-bearing report, fish checklist, station-by-taxon table, or download attachment for the named project.
boundedSearch.limit: This bounded public/indexed search cannot rule out unindexed, unpublished, restricted, or separately titled materials. No author, organizer, or government office was contacted.

projectLineage.whatTheReportShows: ERDB's 2023 Q3 accomplishment report lists an MOA for the Pasig River Biodiversity Assessment Project among MOAs reviewed.
whatItDoesNotShow: The agreement text, partner responsibilities, or any data-sharing terms.
Whether the listed MOA led to completed field work or which taxonomic groups, sites, dates, or methods were covered.
A fish checklist, specimen or voucher table, occurrence file, or station geometry.

conferenceProgramLeads.programEvidence: A Pasig River water-quality assessment presentation using phytoplankton as biological indicators is listed under Yves Christian L. Cabillon, DENR.
A Pasig River composition, abundance, and diversity presentation is listed under Yves Christian L. Cabillon, DENR-ERDB.
A poster is listed comparing Pasig River macroinvertebrate community with a study from approximately 15 years earlier, under Anneraj Velasco, DENR-ERDB.

findings.linkageAssessment: Shared river, year, and ERDB affiliation make these useful retrieval leads, but do not establish that the presentations are components of the DENR-NCR 2024 fish assessment, share samples, or share a data lineage. The phytoplankton and rotifer listings name the same presenter but remain separate source records.

evidenceDecision.decision: Retain the three program topics and the MOA listing as attributed retrieval leads only. They do not supply fish-level evidence or resolve the fish-only gaps in the 2024 DENR-NCR narrative.

nonClaims: An agenda listing does not prove that the presentation or poster occurred or that its abstract, slides, or supporting data were publicly released.
The phytoplankton, rotifer, and macroinvertebrate topics do not identify any fish taxon or establish a fish occurrence.
The symposium topics have not been shown to belong to the 2024 DENR-NCR fish assessment or to share its sampling locations, personnel, or data.
A bounded search that did not locate a dataset is not evidence that the dataset does not exist.
No current presence, absence, catchability, fishing access, legal harvest, safety, geometry, or local habitat claim is established.
nextActions: Continue searching public primary records for the separate Pasig fish assessment, its source-linked species table, collection dates, methods, locality crosswalk, vouchers, and reuse terms.
Keep phytoplankton, rotifer, macroinvertebrate, and fish evidence in separate taxonomic lanes unless a primary source documents their shared project and sampling design.
Continue freshwater, brackish, marine, and wetland evidence searches across NCR; keep the NCR baseline and Luzon phase incomplete.
